key_insight: This paper introduces MahaPOS, a new Marathi part-of-speech tagging dataset, along with BERT-based baseline models tailored for Marathi. It helps close a major resource gap for a high-population language that has been underrepresented in NLP benchmarks.
problem_solved: Marathi NLP lacks large, standardized annotated corpora and reliable evaluation benchmarks, making POS tagging difficult despite the language’s size and importance. The paper addresses the challenges caused by Marathi’s rich morphology, flexible word order, and limited labeled data.
method: Curate and release a Marathi POS tagging dataset (MahaPOS) for standard benchmarking.
Train and evaluate BERT-based models on Marathi POS tagging.
Provide a baseline framework for future Marathi NLP research and comparison.
impact: This work gives AI/ML practitioners a practical benchmark and training resource for building better Marathi language tools. It can accelerate progress in downstream tasks like machine translation, parsing, and information extraction for under-resourced Indic languages.

paper_title: L3Cube-MahaPOS: A Marathi Part-of-Speech Tagging Dataset and BERT Models
paper_authors: Hariom Ingle, Ronit Ghode, Ishwari Gondkar, Jidnyasa Harad, Raviraj Joshi
